findings.issue: ChargeRide Mobility provides a default loss guarantee (DLG) for loans that are also covered under the CGFMU credit guarantee scheme. summary: The compliance review of ChargeRide's Electric Scooter Loans at Dealerships product identified several gaps against the reviewed RBI rules. The key findings include: (1) A high-risk violation of DLD2025:20(ii) due to the provision of a default loss guarantee (DLG) for loans already covered under the CGFMU credit guarantee scheme. (2) A high-risk violation of DLD2025:8(v) as the product feature does not communicate the recovery agent's details to the borrower prior to contact. (3) A medium-risk gap under DLD2025:16(i) as the credit bureau reporting feature does not explicitly state that the reporting is done by the RE or LSPs. These findings highlight critical non-compliance issues that require immediate corrective action.
